title: ThemeManifest
description: Metadata header stored as manifest.json at the root of a .apextheme zip bundle. Derived from src-tauri/src/design_system/theme_pack/manifest.rs.

id.description: Stable machine-readable identifier (slug). Used as primary key for install/uninstall/set-active. Example: "dracula".

name.description: Human-readable display name shown in the theme picker. Example: "Dracula".

author.description: Theme author name or handle. Defaults to empty string when absent.

version.description: Semver version string. No parse validation is done — stored and displayed as-is.

app_schema_version.description: Bundle format version this pack was authored against. Current version is 1. Packs with a version GREATER than the reader's version are rejected. Packs with equal or older versions are accepted; missing fields fall back to defaults.

is_dark.description: true if the pack's color scheme is a dark-mode palette; false for light. Used for theme-picker filtering and media-query matching.

asset_inventory.description: Inventory of all assets bundled under assets/<key> in the zip. Informational at read time — the actual bytes live in the zip entries. Missing entries do not cause an error.

checksum.description: Optional SHA-256 hex checksum over the non-manifest zip entries. Stored as informational field; not verified by the current reader (verification deferred to S9).

PackCapabilities.title: PackCapabilities
PackCapabilities.description: High-level capability flags declared in the manifest. Derived from the asset inventory during write_bundle; stored so readers can gate features without inspecting all assets.

uses_fonts.description: Pack supplies one or more custom font families (assets/ contains FontFace or FontFaceMono entries).

uses_icons.description: Pack supplies a custom icon glyph font (assets/ contains an IconFont entry).

uses_imagery.description: Pack supplies background textures or logo images. STUB — not wired in the current release.

uses_shell_profile.description: Pack contains a shellprofile.json section. STUB — ShellProfile is design-only; the blob is stored verbatim and ignored by the current reader.

AssetInventoryEntry.title: AssetInventoryEntry
AssetInventoryEntry.description: One entry in the manifest's asset inventory. Lists assets bundled under assets/<key> in the zip.

key.description: Asset key — matches the path assets/<key> inside the zip.

AssetKind.title: AssetKind
AssetKind.description: The kind of asset bundled in the zip. Mirrors ui_kit::assets::AssetKind.
